# Feature: Atlas Follow-up — Editor Durability (#751)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement — Closes #751 -->

## Intent

Harden shared-map persistence so 2D/3D edits survive perspective switches, navigation, concurrent editors and hard reload without silent last-write-wins.

## Preconditions

- Bidirectional 2D/3D store from #749.
- `upsert_world_atlas_map` revision CAS (`p_expected_revision`, ERRCODE 40001).
- Authenticated GM editors on a real non-demo world.

## Happy Path

- [ ] GM edits in 3D → dirty → saving → server-confirmed saved; hard reload in a new context shows the same mapId, object ids/counts/transforms.
- [ ] Second concurrent client save triggers revision conflict UI (Reload/Retry); original local draft is not silently overwritten.
- [ ] Undo/redo across 2D/3D remains deterministic for the final saved document.

## Edge Cases

- Autosave timeout / in-flight write while navigating maps.
- Conflict while dirty: autosave paused until Reload or Retry.
- beforeunload warns when dirty.

## Scope

**In:** Persist status machine, serialized saves, conflict banner, navigation guards, durability check.  
**Out:** CRDT / offline collaboration; rewriting non-Atlas save systems; production migrations.

## Security Coverage

- F-03 / B-01 / B-04: RLS + RPC CAS remain authority.
- No production migration.
- SC-01…SC-07: N/A — not a launch ticket.

## Composition

- Proof: `.qa/runs/composition-gate-atlas-followup-editor-durability.md`

## Implementation Notes

- Domain: `atlas-persist-state` — clean/dirty/saving/saved/conflict; never invents `saved` without `save_ok`.
- Hook: serialized `saveCanvas` (`saveInFlightRef`), CAS via `expectedRevision`, `reloadActiveMap`, guarded map switch confirm.
- Workbench: autosave paused on conflict; `beforeunload` when dirty; conflict banner Neu laden / Erneut speichern.
- Gate: `scripts/atlas-worldbuilder-editor-durability-check.mjs`.
